snapshot.stmt: Under joint terminal target-span, every admissible \(\lambda^y\) satisfies the pointwise sanity reduction \(\sum_{\beta_Y}\lambda^y_{\beta_Y}\phi_{Y_{\mathrm b},\beta_Y}(a_{\mathrm t})\psi_{Y_{\mathrm b},\beta_Y}(z_{\mathrm t})=\mathbf 1\{a_{\mathrm t}=y,\ z_{\mathrm t}=y\}\). Consequently, for every attainable bow tensor, \(q^{\mathrm b}_{\beta_X}(y;\lambda^y)=\sum_{a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b}}A_{\mathrm b}[\beta_X,(a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})]B_{\mathcal M,y}(a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\) and \(Q_{z^{\circ},y}(\mathcal M)=\sum_{a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b}}r_{z^{\circ}}[a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b}]B_{\mathcal M,y}(a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\). If \(\lambda^y\) and \(\widetilde\lambda^y\) both satisfy the synthesis equations, their responses coincide; the common coordinate is denoted \(q^{\mathrm b}_{\beta_X}(y)\).

defs.def:bow-target-coefficient: \(r_{z^{\circ}}[a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b}]=\mathbf 1\{z_{\mathrm b}=z^{\circ}\}\) for \((a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\in\mathcal A_{X_{\mathrm b}}^2\).
defs.def:terminal-synthesis: Choose \(\lambda^y\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal L_{Y_{\mathrm b}}}\) satisfying \(\sum_{\beta_Y\in\mathcal L_{Y_{\mathrm b}}}\lambda^y_{\beta_Y}\phi_{Y_{\mathrm b},\beta_Y}(a_{\mathrm t})\psi_{Y_{\mathrm b},\beta_Y}(z_{\mathrm t})=d_y(a_{\mathrm t},z_{\mathrm t})=\mathbf 1\{a_{\mathrm t}=y,\ z_{\mathrm t}=y\}\) for every \(a_{\mathrm t},z_{\mathrm t}\in\mathcal A_{Y_{\mathrm b}}\); a second admissible choice \(\widetilde\lambda^y\) satisfies the same coordinate equations.

snapshot.stmt: For a normalized separable menu on \(G_{\mathrm b}\), if \(e_y\notin\operatorname{span}\{\phi_{Y_{\mathrm b},\beta_Y}:\beta_Y\in\mathcal L_{Y_{\mathrm b}}\}\), then there exist \(\mathcal M,\mathcal M'\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{pp}}^{\mathrm{edge}}(G_{\mathrm b},\mathcal A)\) with \(\mathcal E_{\mathcal I}(\mathcal M)=\mathcal E_{\mathcal I}(\mathcal M')\) and \(Q_{z^{\circ},y}(\mathcal M)\ne Q_{z^{\circ},y}(\mathcal M')\). They may be chosen with singleton exogenous alphabets, a common uniform treatment mechanism, and primitive cell floor at least \(\min\{1/m,1/(2k)\}\).

defs.def:primitive-positive-edge-scm-class: \(\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{pp}}^{\mathrm{edge}}(G,\mathcal A)=\{\mathcal M=((p_s)_{s\in\mathcal S_G},(f_v)_{v\in V}):p_{\mathcal M}^{U}(u)=\prod_{s\in\mathcal S_G}p_s(u_s),\ p_s(u_s)>0,\ f_v(a_v\mid z_{\operatorname{pa}_G(v)},u_v,u_{\operatorname{bi}_G(v)})>0\text{ for every admissible cell}\}\).
defs.def:probe-evidence-map: \(q_{\rho}(\boldsymbol b)=\sum_{a,z}W_{\mathcal M}(a\mid z)\prod_{v\in V}\phi_{v,(j_v,b_v)}(a_v)\psi_{v,(j_v,b_v)}(z_v)\), and \(\mathcal E_{\mathcal I}(\mathcal M)=(q_{\rho}(\boldsymbol b))_{(\rho,\boldsymbol b)\in\mathcal I_q}\).
defs.def:split-port-kernel: \(W_{\mathcal M}(a\mid z)=\sum_{u\in\prod_{s\in\mathcal S_G}\mathcal U_s}\prod_{s\in\mathcal S_G}p_s(u_s)\prod_{v\in V}f_v(a_v\mid z_{\operatorname{pa}_G(v)},u_v,u_{\operatorname{bi}_G(v)})\).

assumptions.ass:independent-sources: The joint exogenous mass satisfies \(p_{\mathcal M}^{U}(u)=\prod_{s\in\mathcal S_G}p_s(u_s)\).
assumptions.ass:instrument-normalization: For every \(v\in V\), \(j_v\in\mathcal J_v\), and \(a_v\in\mathcal A_v\), \(\sum_{b_v\in\mathcal B_{v,j_v}}\phi_{v,(j_v,b_v)}(a_v)=1\).
assumptions.ass:strict-mechanism-positivity: Every admissible cell of every structural kernel \(f_v\) is strictly positive.

snapshot.stmt: Let \(m=\lvert\mathcal A_{X_{\mathrm b}}\rvert\ge2\) and \(k=\lvert\mathcal A_{Y_{\mathrm b}}\rvert\ge2\).  For every normalized separable menu \(\mathcal I\) on \(G_{\mathrm b}\), if \(\operatorname{span}\{\phi_{X_{\mathrm b},\beta_X}:\beta_X\in\mathcal L_{X_{\mathrm b}}\}=\mathbb R^m\) and \(r_{z^{\circ}}\in\operatorname{row}(A_{\mathrm b})\) for every \(z^{\circ}\in\mathcal A_{X_{\mathrm b}}\), then \(\operatorname{rank}(A_{\mathrm b})\ge2m-1\) and \(\lvert\mathcal L_{X_{\mathrm b}}\rvert\ge2m-1\).  The menu \(\mathcal I_{\mathrm b}^{\mathrm{fr}}\) is normalized; its treatment effects and states span \(\mathbb R^m\), its terminal effects and states span \(\mathbb R^k\), \(\operatorname{rank}(A_{\mathrm b}^{\mathrm{fr}})=2m-1\), and every \(r_{z^{\circ}}\) belongs to \(\operatorname{row}(A_{\mathrm b}^{\mathrm{fr}})\).  Consequently every \(Q_{z^{\circ},y}\) is globally identified on \(\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{pp}}^{\mathrm{edge}}(G_{\mathrm b},\mathcal A)\), the exact minimum treatment rank among normalized bow menus whose treatment effects and states span \(\mathbb R^m\), whose terminal effects and states span \(\mathbb R^k\), and which globally identify all atomic queries is \(2m-1\), and this attainment is non-tomographic because \(2m-1<m^2\).  When \(m=k=2\), \(\mathcal I_{\mathrm b}^{\mathrm{fr}}\) is exactly \(\mathcal I_{\mathrm b}^{\dagger}\).

defs.def:binary-bow-menu: At \(X_{\mathrm b}\), use exactly one three-branch instrument with effect-state pairs \((\tfrac12 e_0,\psi^{+})\), \((\tfrac12 e_1,\psi^{+})\), and \((\tfrac12\mathbf 1,\psi^{-})\). At \(Y_{\mathrm b}\), use the two-branch instrument \((e_0,e_0),(e_1,e_1)\). Thus \(A_{\mathrm b}^{\dagger}\) has exactly the three rows \(\tfrac12e_0\otimes\psi^{+},\tfrac12e_1\otimes\psi^{+},\tfrac12\mathbf 1\otimes\psi^{-}\).
defs.def:bow-probe-matrix: \(A_{\mathrm b}[\beta_X,(a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})]=\phi_{X_{\mathrm b},\beta_X}(a_{\mathrm b})\psi_{X_{\mathrm b},\beta_X}(z_{\mathrm b})\) for \(\beta_X\in\mathcal L_{X_{\mathrm b}}\) and \((a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\in\mathcal A_{X_{\mathrm b}}^2\).
defs.def:bow-target-coefficient: \(r_{z^{\circ}}[a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b}]=\mathbf 1\{z_{\mathrm b}=z^{\circ}\}\) for \((a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\in\mathcal A_{X_{\mathrm b}}^2\).
defs.def:finite-alphabet-bow-frontier-menu: After relabeling \(\mathcal A_{X_{\mathrm b}}=\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\), let \(\delta_i\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A_{X_{\mathrm b}}}\) be the \(i\)-th coordinate vector, let \(\mathbf 1_X=\sum_{i=0}^{m-1}\delta_i\), and put \(\rho_i=\tfrac12\delta_i+\tfrac1{2m}\mathbf 1_X\) for \(0\le i<m\).  The finite-alphabet frontier menu \(\mathcal I_{\mathrm b}^{\mathrm{fr}}\) has at \(X_{\mathrm b}\) one instrument with the \(2m-1\) effect-state branches \((\tfrac12\delta_i,\rho_0)\), \(0\le i<m\), and \((\tfrac1{2(m-1)}\mathbf 1_X,\rho_i)\), \(1\le i<m\).  At \(Y_{\mathrm b}\) it has one basis instrument with branches \((e_y,e_y)\), \(y\in\mathcal A_{Y_{\mathrm b}}\).  Its treatment probe matrix \(A_{\mathrm b}^{\mathrm{fr}}\) has rows \(\tfrac12\delta_i\rho_0^{\mathsf T}\), \(0\le i<m\), and \(\tfrac1{2(m-1)}\mathbf 1_X\rho_i^{\mathsf T}\), \(1\le i<m\).
defs.def:global-probe-identification: \(\operatorname{GID}_{\mathcal I}(Q_{x,y})\Longleftrightarrow[\mathcal E_{\mathcal I}(\mathcal M)=\mathcal E_{\mathcal I}(\mathcal M')\Rightarrow Q_{x,y}(\mathcal M)=Q_{x,y}(\mathcal M')]\) for every \(\mathcal M,\mathcal M'\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{pp}}^{\mathrm{edge}}(G,\mathcal A)\).

snapshot.stmt: In \(G_{\mathrm b}\), if \(r_{z^{\circ}}\notin\operatorname{row}(A_{\mathrm b})\), choose \(h\in\ker(A_{\mathrm b})\) with \(r_{z^{\circ}}^{\mathsf T}h\ne0\). The construction \((\mathcal M_h^{+},\mathcal M_h^{-})\) gives two members of \(\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{pp}}^{\mathrm{edge}}(G_{\mathrm b},\mathcal A)\) with identical \(\mathcal E_{\mathcal I}\), unequal \(Q_{z^{\circ},y}\), exactly \(m\) states for the shared edge source, and primitive cell floor at least \(1/(2\max\{m,k\})\).

defs.def:bow-positive-twin-construction: Choose \(h\in\ker(A_{\mathrm b})\) with \(r_{z^{\circ}}^{\mathsf T}h\ne0\), identify the shared-edge alphabet with \(\mathcal A_{X_{\mathrm b}}\), and set \(p(u_{\mathrm b})=1/m\). Give all private sources one state. In both models set \(f_{X_{\mathrm b}}(a_{\mathrm b}\mid u_{\mathrm b})=\mathbf 1\{a_{\mathrm b}=u_{\mathrm b}\}/2+1/(2m)\). With \(T[(a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b}),(u_{\mathrm b},z'_{\mathrm b})]=\mathbf 1\{z_{\mathrm b}=z'_{\mathrm b}\}(\mathbf 1\{a_{\mathrm b}=u_{\mathrm b}\}/(2m)+1/(2m^2))\), set \(g(u_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})=2m h(u_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})-\sum_{a_{\mathrm b}}h(a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\), \(L=\lVert g\rVert_{\infty}\), and \(t=1/(2kL)\). Choose \(y^{\dagger}\ne y\). For \(\sigma\in\{+1,-1\}\), define \(f^{\sigma}_{Y_{\mathrm b}}(\ell\mid z_{\mathrm b},u_{\mathrm b})=1/k+\sigma t g(u_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\) when \(\ell=y\), \(1/k-\sigma t g(u_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\) when \(\ell=y^{\dagger}\), and \(1/k\) otherwise; \(\mathcal M_h^{\sigma}\) is the bow SCM with these source masses and node kernels.

snapshot.stmt: For \(G_{\mathrm b}\) and arbitrary normalized separable probes at both vertices, \(\operatorname{GID}_{\mathcal I}(Q_{z^{\circ},y})\) holds if and only if \(r_{z^{\circ}}\in\operatorname{row}(A_{\mathrm b})\) and \(e_y\in\operatorname{span}\{\phi_{Y_{\mathrm b},\beta_Y}:\beta_Y\in\mathcal L_{Y_{\mathrm b}}\}\). On success, any \(c\) satisfying \(c^{\mathsf T}A_{\mathrm b}=r_{z^{\circ}}^{\mathsf T}\) and any admissible effect-synthesis vector \(\mu^y\) give the synthesis- and coefficient-invariant functional \(Q_{z^{\circ},y}=\sum_{\beta_X\in\mathcal L_{X_{\mathrm b}}}c_{\beta_X}q^{\mathrm b}_{\beta_X}(y)\). If the treatment condition fails, an explicit treatment-null construction gives strictly positive same-evidence models with unequal queries; if the terminal condition fails, an explicit effect-null construction does so with singleton sources and primitive cell floor at least \(\min\{1/m,1/(2k)\}\).

defs.def:bow-probe-matrix: \(A_{\mathrm b}[\beta_X,(a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})]=\phi_{X_{\mathrm b},\beta_X}(a_{\mathrm b})\psi_{X_{\mathrm b},\beta_X}(z_{\mathrm b})\) for \(\beta_X\in\mathcal L_{X_{\mathrm b}}\) and \((a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\in\mathcal A_{X_{\mathrm b}}^2\).

defs.def:terminal-synthesis: Whenever \(e_y\in\operatorname{span}\{\phi_{Y_{\mathrm b},\beta_Y}:\beta_Y\in\mathcal L_{Y_{\mathrm b}}\}\), choose \(\mu^y\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal L_{Y_{\mathrm b}}}\) satisfying \(\sum_{\beta_Y\in\mathcal L_{Y_{\mathrm b}}}\mu^y_{\beta_Y}\phi_{Y_{\mathrm b},\beta_Y}(a_{\mathrm t})=e_y(a_{\mathrm t})=\mathbf 1\{a_{\mathrm t}=y\}\) for every \(a_{\mathrm t}\in\mathcal A_{Y_{\mathrm b}}\); a second admissible choice \(\widetilde\mu^y\) satisfies the same coordinate equations.

assumptions.ass:instrument-normalization: For every \(v\in V\), \(j_v\in\mathcal J_v\), and \(a_v\in\mathcal A_v\), \(\sum_{b_v\in\mathcal B_{v,j_v}}\phi_{v,(j_v,b_v)}(a_v)=1\).

snapshot.stmt: For \(\mathcal I_{\mathrm b}^{\dagger}\), normalization holds for every instrument at both vertices, the treatment effect and state spans over \(\mathcal L_{X_{\mathrm b}}\) are both \(\mathbb R^2\), and the terminal effects \(e_0,e_1\) span \(\mathbb R^2\); indeed the matching terminal branches also satisfy \(e_0\otimes e_0=d_0\) and \(e_1\otimes e_1=d_1\). The treatment rows give \(\operatorname{rank}(A_{\mathrm b}^{\dagger})=3<4\), while \(r_0,r_1\in\operatorname{row}(A_{\mathrm b}^{\dagger})\). Hence both binary intervention-response distributions are globally identified on the latent bow although full treatment-table tomography is impossible. This is query-specific identification in a latent-confounded bow from a non-tomographic disturbing-probe menu.

Every admissible \(\mu^y\) satisfies \(\sum_{\beta_Y}\mu^y_{\beta_Y}\phi_{Y_{\mathrm b},\beta_Y}(a_{\mathrm t})=\mathbf 1\{a_{\mathrm t}=y\}\). Because \(Y_{\mathrm b}\) is terminal and every \(\psi_{Y_{\mathrm b},\beta_Y}\) is normalized, for every attainable bow tensor, \(q^{\mathrm b}_{\beta_X}(y;\mu^y)=\sum_{a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b}}A_{\mathrm b}[\beta_X,(a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})]B_{\mathcal M,y}(a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\) and \(Q_{z^{\circ},y}(\mathcal M)=\sum_{a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b}}r_{z^{\circ}}[a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b}]B_{\mathcal M,y}(a_{\mathrm b},z_{\mathrm b})\). If \(\mu^y\) and \(\widetilde\mu^y\) both satisfy the effect-synthesis equations, their responses coincide; the common coordinate is denoted \(q^{\mathrm b}_{\beta_X}(y)\).
